mission.title: kserve: Can't create Serverless InferenceService when knative is installed in non-default namespace
mission.description: Can't create Serverless InferenceService when knative is installed in non-default namespace. This issue affects 5+ users.

steps.title: Identify kserve troubleshoot symptoms
steps.description:
Check for the issue in your kserve deployment:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n kserve -l app.kubernetes.io/name=kserve
kubectl logs -l app.kubernetes.io/name=kserve -n kserve --tail=100 | grep -i error
```
Look for errors or warnings in the logs that may indicate the issue.

steps.title: Review kserve configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant kserve configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n kserve -l app.kubernetes.io/name=kserve
kubectl get configmap -n kserve -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=kserve
```
**What steps did you take and what happened:**
1. I was running kserve 0.15.0, and created a Serverless InferenceService.
2. I upgraded kserve from 0.15.0 to 0.15.2
3.

steps.title: Confirm Can't create Serverless InferenceService when… is resolved
steps.description:
Verify the fix by checking that the original error no longer occurs:
```bash
kubectl logs -l app.kubernetes.io/name=kserve -n kserve --tail=50 --since=5m
kubectl get events -n kserve --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm that the issue symptoms are gone.
